VK 대릉원 page: the static HTML accessibility list says '없음' for every item, but the bfree data the page renders says facilities exist (see c17).
access.visitkorea 동궁과 월지 accessibility data is dated 2022.02.07, older than 12 months (stale_source). This affects c26, c29 and c30.
VK's homepage link to the Gyeongju tour page (mnu_uid=2517&chaNo=3333) is broken and returns a '비정상적인 메뉴코드' error, so the hours could not be checked against a second official source.
The 종합이용권 table (2종 대릉원·동궁과 월지, card payment possible) exists only inside an HTML comment on the Gyeongju fee page. It is not displayed and must not be used.

suggested_claims.text: 2026년 하회별신굿탈놀이 상설공연은 1~2월 매주 토·일, 3~12월 매주 화~일 오후 2시~3시 하회별신굿탈놀이전수관에서 열리며 관람료는 무료이다(사정에 따라 변경 가능).
한국관광공사 무장애 정보상 하회마을에는 오디오 가이드(한국어, 외국어)가 있다.
한국관광공사 무장애 정보상 하회마을은 출입구에 턱이 없어 휠체어 접근이 가능하고, 장애인 주차장 15면(1·2주차장)과 장애인 화장실이 있으며, 휠체어(사무실 5대·보관함 3대)와 유모차(3대)를 빌릴 수 있다.
하회마을 공식 사이트 메뉴에 온라인 예매(taap.co.kr) 링크가 있다(예매 대상은 페이지에서 확인 필요).

conflicts: Hours: VK gives 09:00-18:00 (last entry 17:30) in summer and 09:00-17:00 (last entry 16:30) in winter. tourandong.com gives 09:00-17:30 and 09:00-16:30, which match VK's last-entry times. The description already tells travellers to check before visiting.

hahoe.or.kr is stale. The bus timetable is dated 2022.03.21, the postcode is the old 760-812 format, the FAQ posts are from 2009, and the rail directions (청량리 새마을 etc.) look outdated. Use it only for c19 to c22 and only with a caution.
The hahoe.or.kr fee table matches tourandong, but labels the resident rate '안동시민 및 예천군민' where tourandong says only 안동시민.

suggested_claims.text: 한국관광공사 자료상 호미곶 해맞이광장 좌표는 위도 36.0768, 경도 129.5680이다(OSM 해맞이광장·상생의 손과 약 100m 이내로 일치).
한국관광공사 무장애 정보상 해맞이광장은 출입구까지 완만한 경사로가 있고 주출입구에 턱이 없으며, 장애인 주차장과 장애인 화장실(휠체어 활동공간 좁음)이 있고 휠체어를 빌릴 수 있다.

conflicts: The Pohang page's 'first sunrise' claim rests on 1999 data and includes a planned-development paragraph that reads as old. Some content looks over 12 months old, but the page shows no update date.
Fees and parking fee: neither the Pohang page nor the VK page states either one. Two lookups found nothing, so these stay unconfirmed. Do not write '무료' without a source.

notes: VisitKorea ms_detail pages are rendered by JavaScript. Fields were read from the page's own data endpoint (POST https://korean.visitkorea.or.kr/call, cmd=TOUR_CONTENT_BODY_DETAIL). The static HTML holds a placeholder accessibility list where every item is '없음'. Collectors reading that raw HTML will produce wrong 'no facilities' claims, as happened with 대릉원 c17.
Hahoe c3: the coordinate is the entrance parking lot, about 1.6km from the OSM village centroid. Label it as an entrance coordinate.
Stale sources: access.visitkorea 동궁과 월지 (2022.02.07) and hahoe.or.kr (bus timetable 2022, FAQ 2009).
Not found after lookups: payment for all three places, fees and parking fee for 호미곶, and languages for 대릉원. Report these as unconfirmed with a reason, not as blank.

Every claim's source was opened with curl -sL, and all returned HTTP 200. Lookups: the Gyeongju 대릉원 page link is broken, hahoemask.co.kr did not respond, and the hahoe.or.kr 탈놀이 page gave the 2026 performance schedule.
